Made for a quick break. Stay for a good move.

Make a bigger universe.

Tap one of the five lanes. Your next planet falls into it. Touching planets with the same number merge into the next number.

Merges can start a chain reaction. The more matches in a chain, the more points you earn. Keep room at the top!

A fair little game

There are no cash prizes or tokens. New games are always free. You get one free undo per run.

Your data

Practice progress stays in this browser. In Telegram, identity is verified on the server before purchases. Payment records and paid boosters are kept to deliver purchases and resolve support requests. Ads stay off until an approved provider is configured.

Payment help: /paysupport in the game bot.
